snippet.title: CliffKingdom reveal trailer
snippet.description:
The lighthouse has gone dark! You awake as Mothboy, last in a long line of lightkeepers summoned when something goes wrong. In this action packed adventure you climb, fight and explore the depths of Cliff Kingdom searching for the lost light.

Wishlist on steam  - https://store.steampowered.com/app/3839500/Cliff_Kingdom/
